title: Undefined or drifting purpose
canonical_definition: The solution is built or used without a stable, bounded and accountable purpose.
failure_mechanism: Ambiguous purpose permits uncontrolled requirements, data use and deployment boundaries.

primary_questions.question: Do declared and implemented uses materially diverge?

atomic_tests.title: Purpose consistency
atomic_tests.description: Compare declared, implemented and operational uses.

absence_test_requirements: All material use paths are compared with the approved purpose.
false_positive_guards: Editorial name differences alone do not prove purpose drift.
prohibited_inferences: Do not infer absence from a single README.

hard_gate_effect.CONFIRMED_PRESENT: Block Deployment until purpose and implementation are reconciled.

normative_source_mappings.title: Internal AI Governance Process
normative_source_mappings.mapping_rationale: Defines the organizational purpose and ownership record.

finding_definitions.title: Purpose is undefined or materially inconsistent
